recovery_inventory.rule: The other 65 historical evidence objects remain semantically unlabeled; no replacement gold text was synthesized.

case_findings.finding: The correct same-transmission/different-transmission contrastive-pair proposition exists on teacher page 2 at F1 0.468085 but is absent from the current top-12 region candidate set; page 2 itself is nevertheless represented in top-12.
The correct wireless 13.4-27.8% proposition exists on teacher page 4 at F1 0.5/0.486486, while current top-12 retains the wired 10.8-19.9% proposition instead; page 4 itself is represented.
Bounded multi-proposition bundles improve lexical alignment only modestly on the current candidate set, indicating composition is not the primary measured residual under the legacy lexical oracle.

rationale: For all six preserved Codex teacher claims, the expected page is already represented among current top-12 regions, yet multiple exact target propositions on those pages are absent from the candidate set.
Expected-page best-single lexical F1 materially exceeds current top-12 best-single F1 (0.399991 vs 0.319085 on grouped claims; 0.321019 vs 0.282601 on unique atoms).
Current-candidate bundle-3 improves grouped lexical F1 only from 0.319085 to 0.334795 and unique-atom F1 only from 0.282601 to 0.288867.
Naive two- and three-sentence fixed-budget retrieval reduces both 9-paper historical page recall and teacher lexical alignment.
Atomization does not make legacy lexical F1 a sufficient semantic metric, so semantic-support evaluation remains a separate research requirement.

next_bounded_research: Test page-conditioned proposition retrieval: use current retrieval only to identify high-value pages, then rank exact propositions across all text on those selected pages under the existing downstream context budget.
Research hybrid sparse+dense and late-interaction reranking only against the residual left after the zero-model page-conditioned test; do not download a new model before this comparison is designed.
Add semantic-support evaluation alongside, not instead of, the frozen legacy lexical metric.
